name: B5000 - Endpoint App Access Control
description: Intent: Block-tier hard enforcement on Endpoint App access at sensitivity floor [3,4] — shuts down execution of explicitly-prohibited applications on the endpoint (the customer-extension Unauthorized app list). Exclusions: scoped to apps in Endpoint_Apps_Unauthorized_[is]; ships disabled by default — populate the Unauthorized app list with your org-specific prohibited applications before enabling, otherwise nothing is blocked. Coordinate enablement with W5000 reviews so the prohibition signal is well-understood before turning hard-block on. Requirements: WIP — pending analyst testing.
